title: The composition law for $Rf_!$
statement:
Use the finite-level coefficient datum of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed]: $k$ is a field, $\ell$ is a prime invertible in $k$, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ is finite, $n\geq1$, and $\Lambda=A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $f:X\to Y$ and $g:Y\to S$ be separated finite-type morphisms between finite-type $k$-schemes [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Let $Rf_!$ denote the compact-support direct image of [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], restricted to the category $\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)$ of pro-etale complexes with an etale-origin witness [def-sf-etale-origin-subcategory]. These functors preserve the bounded-below etale-origin class. There is a canonical natural isomorphism
$$\alpha_{g,f}:Rg_!Rf_!\xrightarrow{\sim}R(g\circ f)_!$$
of functors $\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(X,\Lambda)\to\mathcal D^+_{\mathrm{et}}(S,\Lambda)$, independent of all compactification choices under the comparisons of [prop-compactification-coherence-detailed]. Under the canonical identity and composition identifications it is the identity when $f$ or $g$ is an identity. For any third separated finite-type morphism $h:S\to T$ with $T$ a finite-type $k$-scheme, it is associative: the two composites $Rh_!Rg_!Rf_!\to R(hgf)_!$ agree after inserting the canonical associator.

proof.text: Use the existing bounded-below etale compact-support functors and their specified compositor, identity comparison, equality transport, and associative and unital equations. These are the declared upstream realizations in LowerShriekComposition of [lem-amb-etale-compact-comparisons]; their construction is the proper/open compactification route of this unit. Restrict the pro-etale compact-support functors to the full origin subcategories, using the existing preservation of etale origin.

proof.text: Let Phi_X be the canonical equivalence from bounded-below etale complexes to the full origin subcategory, and let tau_f: Phi_X O_f -> E_f Phi_Y be the specified compact-support site comparison followed by inverse bounded-below compatibility. Lift its components to the full subcategory. The two fully faithful preimage operations defining originComposition recover their input after whiskering. Expanding the defining ordered model and cancelling adjacent inverse comparisons therefore gives (Phi_X alpha_fg) tau_fg = (tau_f O_g)(E_f tau_g)(alpha_et_fg Phi_Z). Equality transport satisfies the analogous square by equality induction.

proof.text: The same preimage computation for the prescribed identity comparison gives Phi_X i_X = tau_id (i_et_X Phi_X). For the left unit, use naturality of tau_f at the etale identity comparison, the compositor equation from the preceding step, the equality-transport square, and the etale left-unit equation. For the right unit, use naturality of i_Y at tau_f instead. Postcompose by the appropriate invertible tau and cancel; faithful precomposition by Phi_X reflects the resulting equations. The private transported_unit_left and transported_unit_right lemmas carry out these calculations in arbitrary categories.

proof.text: For three morphisms, precompose both associativity paths by Phi_X and postcompose by tau_f(gh). Apply the equality-transport square and the four compositor squares. Naturality of tau_h at the etale compositor alpha_et_fg moves that compositor past tau_h. The etale associativity equation then replaces the three final comparison-pullback maps. Naturality of alpha_gh at tau_f identifies the remaining two paths. Cancel tau_f(gh) and reflect equality by full faithfulness. The private transported_associativity lemma proves this pasting calculation for arbitrary categories, retaining the specified associators and equality transports.

proof.text: For a retained coefficient-realized witness (K,L,alpha), keep exactly its bounded-below etale complex L. Let E be the canonical coefficient-realization equivalence. The unit of the induced derived equivalence identifies nu^*L with D(E.inverse)D(E.functor)(nu^*L). Compose with D(E.inverse) applied to the inverse derived-composition comparison and the ambient inclusion of alpha. This gives the required isomorphism from nu^*L to originWitnessFixedAmbient(K), proving originWitnessFixed_property with L.property as its lower-bound witness. No arbitrary existence witness is chosen.
